scope: STATIC SOURCE ENDPOINTS ONLY. No generated frames, continuous motion, song synchronization, final edit, or full scene acceptance.

inspection.note: Scratch FFmpeg-only crops are review aids at native scale, not production inputs. New operator crops must preserve reviewed functional content and be bound to their own exact bytes.

pairs.observed: The interior reverse view starts with door already beginning to open and woman touching its handle, then wider opening with her hand released and Jaro still outside. One left-hinged leaf, home shelf now empty in both frames, coat still on peg, full bodies visible.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Do not claim a fully closed first frame; story-before and physical endpoint differ in that respect. Begin on the already-started opening as cut continuation. The brief social smile is subtle; generated expression must establish and lose that social mask rather than make her warmly reassured. Keep hinge/frame rigid despite minor drawn alignment differences.

pairs.observed: Jaro offers his RIGHT palm from outside; she retains her own space and he lowers it while moving back, leaving her doorway open. Room, coats, shelf and bodies remain compatible.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Actual retreat must be a supported half-step, not a shrinking body or sliding shoes. One offered hand, no clasp/pull. End framing has complete feet but modest floor margin; preserve this in motion.

authority: Root owns canon/contract changes. Artist and reviewer are separate. No generator or GPU operation performed by reviewer.
